title: STUDIES IN LITERATURE, CULTURE AND SOCIETY: ST/LITERATURE IN TRANSLATION
rpt_for_credit: This course is repeatable for 8 credits
description: Study of literature in its relationship to society and culture; study of literary culture. Topics change from term to term.
recommendations: Sophomore standing; 8 credits of ENG 200-level or above.
books_html: Low-cost:  Course material total cost is $40 or less.
clssnotes:
Does not meet a period requirement for the English major. Hybrid section; both on-site meetings and online component. This section meets 75% in-person and 25% asynchronously online.
